# Face detection (vendored)

`@mediapipe/face_detection` 0.4.1646425229 from npm, Apache License 2.0 (Google). Only the short-range model and its WebAssembly files are kept.
Used by the Birthday Cake selfie booth so the crown follows the face. It runs entirely on the phone; no image ever leaves it.
Loaded lazily (only when the booth opens). Hosted here so nothing loads from Google at runtime.
